shortDescription: Information module for Endpoint Analytics Endpoints Count

options.name: aiSpoofingTrustLevel
options.description: AiSpoofingTrustLevel query parameter. Trust level of the endpoint due to AI spoofing. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

options.name: ancPolicy
options.description: AncPolicy query parameter. ANC policy. Only exact match will be returned.

options.name: authMethod
options.description: AuthMethod query parameter. Authentication method. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: changedProfileTrustLevel
options.description: ChangedProfileTrustLevel query parameter. Trust level of the endpoint due to changing profile labels. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

options.name: concurrentMacTrustLevel
options.description: ConcurrentMacTrustLevel query parameter. Trust level of the endpoint due to concurrent MAC address. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

options.name: deviceType
options.description: DeviceType query parameter. Type of device to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: hardwareManufacturer
options.description: HardwareManufacturer query parameter. Hardware manufacturer to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: hardwareModel
options.description: HardwareModel query parameter. Hardware model to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: ip
options.description: Ip query parameter. IP address to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: ipBlocklistDetected
options.description: IpBlocklistDetected query parameter. Flag to fetch endpoints hitting IP blocklist or not.

options.name: macAddress
options.description: MacAddress query parameter. MAC address to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: macAddresses
options.description: MacAddresses query parameter. List of MAC addresses to filter on. Only exact matches will be returned.

options.name: natTrustLevel
options.description: NatTrustLevel query parameter. Trust level of the endpoint due to NAT access. Possible values are 'low', 'medium', 'high'.

options.name: operatingSystem
options.description: OperatingSystem query parameter. Operating system to search for. Partial string is allowed.

options.name: postureStatus
options.description: PostureStatus query parameter. Posture status.

options.name: profilingStatus
options.description: ProfilingStatus query parameter. Profiling status of the endpoint. Possible values are 'profiled', 'partialProfiled', 'notProfiled'.

options.name: randomMac
options.description: RandomMac query parameter. Flag to fetch endpoints having randomized MAC or not.

options.name: registered
options.description: Registered query parameter. Flag to fetch manually registered or non-registered endpoints.

options.name: trustScore
options.description: TrustScore query parameter. Overall trust score of the endpoint. It can be provided either as a number value (e.g. 5), or as a range (e.g. 3-7). Provide value as '-' if you want to search for all endpoints where trust score is not assigned.

options.name: unauthPortDetected
options.description: UnauthPortDetected query parameter. Flag to fetch endpoints exposing unauthorized ports or not.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: weakCredDetected
options.description: WeakCredDetected query parameter. Flag to fetch endpoints having weak credentials or not.
